description: Ministry of Power & Renewable Energy - Order to acquire the land in No. 75A, Walgama, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegall District - Order to acquire the land in No. 75A Muththettulandewattha, Bangalawatta, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains orders under the Ceylon Electricity Board Act approving the acquisition of specific lands (Muththettulanda and Muththettulandewaththa) for the Ceylon Electricity Board's requirements. The content includes detailed descriptions of the lands, their boundaries, locations, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a minister is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about the minister exercising statutory powers related to land acquisition.
